lines.text: Joseph, a good and righteous Council member from Arimathea, asked Pilate for the body of Jesus.
Joseph wrapped the body in a linen cloth and laid it in a tomb cut into the rock, and the women watched.
Very early on the first day of the week, the women found the stone still in place and the body gone.
Two men in radiant apparel told the women that Jesus had risen, and they remembered that He said He would rise on the seventh day.
The women told the Eleven, who did not believe them, but Peter ran to the tomb and saw only linen cloths.
